summary: Nova Ltd. filed a Form 6-K reporting the results of its annual general meeting of shareholders held on June 18, 2026. The meeting approved three proposals described in the proxy statement furnished on May 14, 2026. This is a routine disclosure of shareholder voting results and does not constitute a special-situations event. No deal terms, acquisitions, divestitures, or other extraordinary corporate actions are present. The filing is merely a procedural update required under SEC rules.
